bodyHtml:
§373C-44  Labor market information development program.  The department of labor and industrial relations shall conduct a labor market information development program to develop employment and unemployment demographics and to conduct labor market area industrial economic analysis in fulfilling the responsibilities of section 373C-23. [L 1983, c 193, pt of §1]

 

Note

 

  Section reproduced to correct printing error in main volume.
